title: Energy-isolation observation
instructions: Collect visual and advisory-sensor observations only. Never declare equipment deenergized, approve entry, or replace a qualified person's certified test procedure.

checkpoints.title: Observe visible PPE
checkpoints.evidence_prompt: Report visible hard hat, high-visibility apparel, gloves, eye protection, and any uncertainty.

checkpoints.title: Observe lockout-tag evidence
checkpoints.evidence_prompt: Describe any visible lockout tag or isolation-device label; do not infer the device state.

checkpoints.title: Require qualified-person verification
checkpoints.evidence_prompt: State that visual evidence and advisory field readings cannot establish a deenergized condition.
